stem.text: A pipe has a length of $2.0\,\text{m}$. It is open at one end and closed at the other end.
A stationary sound wave is set up within the pipe. There are four nodes (N) and four antinodes (A) within the length of the pipe.

stem.alt: Horizontal pipe with the labels N and A alternating along its length, and a dimension arrow labelled 2.0 m along the pipe.

stem.text: What is the wavelength of the sound wave?
